device.description: 10-bit 6 MSPS 4-input simultaneous-sampling pipelined ADC with 16-word FIFO and parallel uP interface
device.note: ths10064.pdf (SLAS255B) p.2 recommended operating conditions, p.5 single conversion timing (DATA_AV 6.5 x tc + 15 ns, tc max 175 ns) and pinout, p.6 terminal functions, p.16 conversion modes, p.19 data format (Tables 3-6), p.22 control register map and addressing (Tables 7-8), p.23 initialization, p.24-25 CR0 (Tables 9-11), p.26 CR1 (Table 12), p.27-28 FIFO trigger level and DATA_AV type (Tables 13-14), p.29-32 read/write timing

registers.name: CR0
registers.note: control register 0 (RA1 RA0 = 00); reset values: DIFF0 = 1, all else 0 (differential AINP-AINM)

registers.name: CR1
registers.note: control register 1 (RA1 RA0 = 01); reset values: bits 5 and 4 = 1 (DATA_P, DATA_T), all else 0

commands.name: CR1 write with RESET = 1
commands.note: writing 1 to CR1 bit 0 resets CR0/CR1 to their reset values (and the FIFO pointers)

pages: p.2 (ROC), p.5 (single conversion timing, pinout), p.6 (terminal functions), p.16 (conversion modes), p.19 (data format), p.22-28 (control registers, FIFO, DATA_AV), p.29-32 (timing)
notModeled: analog inputs, references (internal/external VREF select), REFOUT: the result is always the 0 V code; codeFormat follows CR1 BIN/2s for the power-on differential configuration (0 V differential = 000h twos complement / mid-scale binary); in single-ended configurations 0 V lies below the VREFM-VREFP input range
CS1 (active-high chip select): the model selects on CS0 alone; CS1 must be held high

R/W mode (CR1 bit 6 = 1: WR becomes R/W, RD disabled): stored only; the bus always uses separate RD and WR (the power-on/reset setting); the datasheet notes RD/WR start conditions are unknown and the first access must be a write
addresses RA1 RA0 = 10 and 11 (reserved) are ignored
the channel sequence (CHSEL/DIFF/SCAN autoscan of up to 4 inputs) is stored only; every read returns the 0 V code
test mode (CR0 TEST1/TEST0: VREFP, mid-scale, VREFM test voltages) is stored only; reads still return the 0 V code
offset cancellation (CR1 OFFSET) is stored only
pipeline latency (5 CONV_CLK cycles) and the CONV_CLK-to-read setup times are not modeled (the code is constant)
tDf uses the 5 ns maximum data hold time after the first CS invalid (th)

16-word FIFO: no FIFO is modeled; each read returns the 0 V code; FIFO reset (FRST), overflow and the trigger level TRIG (DATA_AV after 1/4/8/14... values, Table 13) are stored only: DATA_AV asserts after every conversion (trigger level 1)

conversion time: single conversion mode (CR0 MODE = 1) uses the one-input DATA_AV delay 1152.5 ns (6.5 x tc + 15 ns, tc max); more inputs take one tc more each; continuous mode (MODE = 0) starts a conversion on every CONV_CLK falling edge with time 0
DATA_AV pulse mode: pulse width modeled as 83 ns (half a CONV_CLK period at the maximum CONV_CLK frequency); level mode clears on the first read (the datasheet: the first of the TL reads)
CR0 and CR1 are write only (no read-back exists)
power down (CR0 PD) blocks conversions; reads and writes still work, as the datasheet states
vcc is the union of DVDD and BVDD ranges (BVDD 3-5.25 V for the output buffers)
variants: THS1206 is the 12-bit relative (D10/RA0, D11/RA1 shared, RBACK read-back).
